title: Collective Autonomous Vehicle Routing Needs Social Awareness for Coexistence with Human Drivers
abstract: arXiv:2610.13439v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Collective Autonomous Vehicle (AV) route choices in real-world traffic networks can create externalities for Human-Driven Vehicles (HDVs), as routes that benefit AVs may increase travel times for other road users. To address this, we introduce a social component, the marginal cost, to the selfish travel time AV reward. Marginal cost captures an AV's impact on other road users by comparing their travel times with those in a counterfactual simulation in which the AV is removed.   We study AV route choice in mixed-autonomy traffic settings using Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), where AVs learn routing policies through repeated interactions with the traffic environment. Experiments on the real-world networks of Ingolstadt and Provins show that incorporating marginal cost into the AV reward not only limits the increase in HDV travel times and shortens AV travel times relative to selfish AV routing, but also improves overall system

translated_title: 集体自动驾驶车辆路径规划需要社会意识才能与人类驾驶员共存
translated_abstract: 在真实交通网络中，集体自动驾驶车辆（AV）的路径选择可能对人类驾驶车辆（HDV）产生外部性，因为有利于自动驾驶车辆的路线可能会增加其他道路使用者的出行时间。为解决这一问题，我们在自动驾驶车辆的自私出行时间奖励中引入了一个社会性成分——边际成本。边际成本通过将其他道路使用者的出行时间与反事实模拟（即移除该自动驾驶车辆后的模拟）中的出行时间进行对比，来刻画该自动驾驶车辆对其他道路使用者的影响。我们使用多智能体强化学习（MARL）研究混合自动驾驶交通环境下的自动驾驶车辆路径选择问题，其中自动驾驶车辆通过与交通环境的反复交互学习路由策略。在英戈尔施塔特和普罗万两个真实路网上的实验表明，将边际成本纳入自动驾驶车辆奖励不仅限制了人类驾驶车辆出行时间的增加，相较于自私路由策略还缩短了自动驾驶车辆自身的出行时间，同时提升了整体系统性能。
tldr: 在自动驾驶车辆的奖励中引入衡量其对他车影响的边际成本，能让混合交通中的人类驾驶员与自动驾驶车辆双方都获益，从而实现更和谐的人机共存。
en_tdlr: Adding a marginal-cost social component to autonomous vehicles' routing rewards reduces their negative externalities on human drivers, improving travel times for both and enabling better coexistence in mixed-autonomy traffic.
